caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden architectural frame with two tall vertical openings, separated by a central vertical wooden bar. The frame has a simple, straight-edged top shelf and base, both rendered in a medium brown color, with visible wood grain texture. Above the two openings are pointed arches, each formed by symmetrical curves meeting at a peak at the center, and each arch contains a smaller cutout towards its base, shaped like a pointed oval. The wood structure, including the columns and arches, is all depicted in shades of brown, with subtle shading to suggest depth and the three-dimensionality of the frame. The background is plain and off-white, offering no additional objects or embellishments.
title: Altar Rail Gate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
